text:
morgan: quick q — seeing 301 redirects from the ALB on :443 for service `inference-gateway` which also has a healthcheck at /healthz. terraform module has an annotation set `alb.ingress.kubernetes.io/ssl-redirect: \"true\"`. Health checks are failing. anyone seen TLS redirect + healthcheck mismatch?

alex: which ingress controller and target group config are you using? aws-load-balancer-controller? also is healthcheck protocol set to HTTPS in the TF module?

sam: yup, seen this. ALB follows redirects for browser/client traffic but the target group health check is separate. If the target group health_check is HTTPS and the backend redirects HTTP->HTTPS, you can loop or get a non-200. Two common fixes: set the healthcheck protocol to HTTP and use traffic-port, or expose a non-redirecting path for probes.

morgan: we are on aws-load-balancer-controller and our terraform uses aws_lb_target_group with a `health_check { protocol = \"HTTPS\" }` from the module defaults. switching that to HTTP in staging made health checks pass. want to be sure there's no hidden downside before rolling prod.

alex: downside if your pod expects TLS (envoy or sidecar doing mTLS) — switching to HTTP for probes might break checks that rely on TLS termination at the pod. if backend is plain HTTP behind the controller, HTTP health checks are fine.

sam: another option is a dedicated probe path that never redirects, e.g. `/healthz/no-redirect`, and point the alb healthcheck to that. example annotations folks use: ```
alb.ingress.kubernetes.io/healthcheck-protocol: HTTP
alb.ingress.kubernetes.io/healthcheck-path: /healthz/no-redirect
alb.ingress.kubernetes.io/healthcheck-port: \"traffic-port\"
alb.ingress.kubernetes.io/ssl-redirect: \"true\"
alb.ingress.kubernetes.io/healthcheck-interval-seconds: \"10\"
```

alex: fwiw, ALB target group health checks treat 301/302 as failure, so relying on matcher that accepts 3xx won't help. safer to use an explicit no-redirect probe.

infra-bot: INF-492 created: add /healthz/no-redirect + terraform var to control target_group healthcheck protocol/port. assignee: morgan.

morgan: thanks — i'll open a quick PR to change the TF var default for staging and add the probe endpoint. pinging @alex for review once it's up :thumbsup:
